scope_guards: No Planning Data entity or current application was invented where an exact official match was not established.
The DG allocation remains policy provenance rather than a site-specific consent.
The Barking Town Centre Strategy is programme-level context and is not converted into a Bamford Road dwelling capacity.
No capacity was imported from an inaccessible or unscreened appendix.
Street-register evidence is not used as a red-line, ownership or HMLR title boundary.
Strategy approval is not treated as commencement, completion or current permission finality.
No score or promotion is written without an exact application, geometry, title relation and executed overlays.
